prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Add a critical-pair Laplacian on undirected edges, weighting each edge by the product of case-relative criticality ranks (quantile of 2D slack, mapped to [0,1] via a soft rank), so adjacent critical nodes are pulled to the same tier and critical-pair cross-tier drops, which the probe correlations say is the strongest predictor of TNS.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.123 robust(mean-std)=+0.006 min_case=+0.005 seed_std=0.041 tns_mean=+0.032 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.088 dWNS=+13.1% dTNS=+6.8% per-seed=[+0.05 +0.03 +0.18]
  C2: score=+0.030 dWNS=+4.7% dTNS=+2.8% per-seed=[+0.10 -0.00 -0.00]
  C3: score=+0.005 dWNS=+1.1% dTNS=+0.6% per-seed=[-0.01 +0.01 +0.01]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->120, wcut 421->363, crit_cross 0.011->0.011, repair_flips 103->82, changed-vs-baseline 6.8%
  C2: cut 318->307, wcut 1007->961, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->232, changed-vs-baseline 5.7%
  C3: cut 582->584, wcut 1955->1963, crit_cross 0.069->0.074, repair_flips 353->346, changed-vs-baseline 3.1%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response:
(1) Partially. Gains concentrate on C1 (score +0.088, dWNS +13.1%, dTNS +6.8%); C2/C3 near-flat. Hypothesis only weakly supported: crit_cross unchanged on C1/C2 and rose on C3 (0.069→0.074), so the intended critical-pair mechanism isn't visibly firing—gains track cut/wcut reduction (421→363) and fewer repair_flips (103→82), i.e., general cut minimization, not criticality weighting.
(2) C1 moved most; C3 slightly worsened cut/wcut and crit_cross.
(3) Seed spread high (std 0.041; C1 per-seed +0.05/+0.03/+0.18) — one seed drives the mean; not yet acceptable.
(4) Verify the soft-rank weights actually differentiate edges (log weight distribution); if near-uniform, sharpen the rank mapping and re-test.
